T01.message: Reflex typeface used as the first family
T01.fix: Pick a face by character class (references/reflex-lists.md); if this face is a deliberate choice, record it under AWARDS.md ## Exceptions

T02.fix: Self-host the woff2 files with font-display and a size-adjusted fallback

T03.message: Display size above 12vw or unclamped vw
T03.fix: Lock display type to the artboard with clamp(min, Xvw, max), max ≈ 12–13vw

T04.fix: Set display tracking at -0.04em or looser by choice; past -0.06em the letters collide at display sizes

T05.fix: Add font-display: swap (or optional for decorative faces) to avoid invisible text

T06.fix: Declare a metric-compatible fallback with size-adjust/ascent-override to avoid reflow when the real face lands

T07.message: Body text set against reading (justified, capitals, tight leading, wide tracking or under 14px)
T07.fix: Running text wants ragged-right, sentence case, leading 1.4–1.6, normal tracking and at least 16px; keep the effects for display lines

T08.message: Flat type hierarchy (h1 under 1.5× the body size, rendered)
T08.fix: Let the scale carry the hierarchy: a display step well clear of body, then fewer, wider steps

C01.message: Text contrast below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text)
C01.fix: Adjust ink or ground; large text (24 px, or 18.66 px bold) may use 3:1, all other text needs 4.5:1, measured against what is actually behind it and in the focus state

C02.fix: Use a warm or cool near-black/off-white unless pure black is diegetic; record diegetic use under AWARDS.md ## Exceptions

C03.message: More than 6 distinct hues in the tokens
C03.fix: Winners run 2–4 tokens; variety comes from change over time, not simultaneity

C04.fix: Emphasis comes from weight, size or a colour field, not background-clip: text

C05.message: Ground differs from the DESIGN.md ground token (rendered)
C05.fix: Paint body (and main, when it has a fill) with the ground token, or correct DESIGN.md to the ground the world actually uses

M01.fix: Add a reduced tier (no spatial movement; keep opacity/colour/state) via CSS media query and gsap.matchMedia / matchMedia in JS

M02.message: Global 0.01ms animation kill under reduced motion
M02.fix: Reduced motion is a tier, not a kill switch: keep feedback and state transitions

M03.message: Scrubbed tween with an ease other than none
M03.fix: Scroll-linked tweens must use ease: 'none'; the scrub value supplies the smoothing

M04.fix: Apply will-change only during a known animation and only to the moving element

M05.message: CSS scroll-behavior: smooth together with a smooth-scroll library
M05.fix: Remove scroll-behavior: smooth; Lenis owns scrolling

M06.message: pin: true used alongside position: sticky
M06.fix: Prefer sticky stages with invisible rails; if pinning, do not also make the element sticky

M07.fix: Animate transforms, clip-path or use FLIP; layout properties force reflow every frame

M08.message: Infinite loop without a visibility/intersection pause
M08.fix: Pause repeat:-1 loops when the tab is hidden or the element is off-screen

A01.fix: Wrap the page content in <main>; add <header>/<nav>/<footer> where they exist

A02.fix: Write alt text (or alt="" for decorative images)

A03.message: Heading structure broken (no h1, several h1, or skipped levels)
A03.fix: One h1 per page; no skipped levels; visual size comes from CSS, not from the heading level

A04.message: <canvas> without aria-hidden or an accessible name
A04.fix: Mark decorative canvases aria-hidden="true" and keep a semantic DOM mirror of any text drawn in WebGL

A05.fix: Use <button> or <a>; they come with keyboard and focus behaviour for free

A06.fix: Theme the focus ring from the tokens; it is a browser surface that carries the design

A07.message: outline: none without a replacement focus style
A07.fix: Keep :focus-visible styling when removing default outlines

A08.message: Custom cursor without a coarse-pointer guard
A08.fix: Enable custom cursors only under (pointer: fine) and (hover: hover); hide them on touch

A10.fix: Autoplay requires muted and playsinline; add a poster and respect reduced motion

A11.message: Pointer-only interaction (drag/hold) without a keyboard handler
A11.fix: Every gesture needs a keyboard equivalent (arrow keys, Enter/Space, Escape)

A12.message: Focus ring below 3:1 against what surrounds it (rendered)
A12.fix: Take the ring colour from the tokens and check it at 3:1 against every ground it can sit on (WCAG 2.2 non-text contrast); offset it or add a second contrasting ring where one colour cannot reach both

A13.fix: Make the first focusable element a same-page link that skips to <main> (visible on focus)

A14.message: Touch target under 24 px beside another target (rendered, phone)
A14.fix: Give each control at least 24 × 24 px, or 24 px of clear space from its neighbours (WCAG 2.2 target size); aim for 44 px on the primary actions

A15.fix: Make every id unique; labels, aria references and fragment links resolve to the first one only

A16.message: axe-core reports a WCAG 2.2 A/AA violation (rendered)
A16.fix: Fix what axe names at the node it points to; serious and critical impacts block, moderate and minor are P2

A17.message: Viewport meta stops pinch zoom (user-scalable=no or maximum-scale under 2)
A17.fix: Drop user-scalable and maximum-scale from the viewport meta; a gesture the page needs is handled with touch-action on that element, never by locking zoom (WCAG 1.4.4)

A18.message: Touch target under 44 × 44 px on a phone (rendered); the jury's usability walk caps Usability at 7 on it
A18.fix: Give the control a 44 × 44 px hit area under (pointer: coarse) with padding or min-height, keeping the type as drawn; links inside running text are exempt

L01.fix: Use fluid widths, max-width or vw-locked values

L02.message: 100vw width can overflow with a vertical scrollbar
L02.fix: Use 100% or inline-size with overflow-x: clip on the container

L04.message: Identical card grid (icon + heading + text × n)
L04.fix: Cards are the lazy container; vary structure by content or use a list, a rail or poster blocks

L05.message: Eyebrow/kicker label above a heading, BEM parts like hero__eyebrow included
L05.fix: Delete the label; let the heading carry its own weight. Keep it only when WORLD names a metadata world (catalogue, archive, spec sheet, call sheet, timetable), with audit-ignore: L05

L06.fix: Reveals start from a visible state or are set by the same code that animates them; a failed script or a skipped trigger must leave text readable

L07.fix: Cap running text at about 60–75ch with max-width on the text column, not the section

L08.message: Body text touching the viewport edge on a phone (rendered)
L08.fix: Give the text column the gutter token on both sides at every width

L09.message: Blank band: a whole viewport with no content in it (rendered)
L09.fix: Fill it, shorten the spacer or the pin, or check that the section meant to sit there renders at this width; a deliberate pause goes under AWARDS.md ## Exceptions

L10.message: Lopsided section on tablet or phone: content keeps to one narrow side (rendered)
L10.fix: Let the column take the width at this breakpoint, or balance the empty side with the section's own media; deliberate asymmetry goes under ## Exceptions

L11.message: Text, a heading or an action covered by something painted over it at a scroll position (rendered)
L11.fix: Move the covering layer (a canvas island, a drawn line, a cast shadow, a wrapper) off the text's box at that position, or give the text a lane of its own; a small fixed header passing over the page is not counted

L12.message: Outer margins differ left and right at desktop width (rendered)
L12.fix: Set one pair of page margins and hang the navigation and every text block from them; keep asymmetry inside the grid, never in the frame

L13.message: Lopsided section on desktop: text in one half and nothing in the other (rendered)
L13.fix: Close the empty side with the section's own picture, a second column, a list or a figure, or let the text take the width; a void is placed only when something closes it

L14.message: A section of running text with no heading naming it (rendered)
L14.fix: Open the section with a heading in the heading face that names what it holds (“The rooms”, “Prices”), set on the page's anchor line; a small label is not a heading

L15.message: Two or more screens that are mostly plain ground (rendered)
L15.fix: Make the main element larger, bring the section's picture or full content into the screen, or take the space out; one deliberate rest per page, closed by something on its far side

P01.fix: Set width/height (or aspect-ratio) to avoid layout shift; lazy-load images below the fold

P02.fix: Export WebP/AVIF at the display size; keep the largest image under ~300 KB

P03.message: glTF/GLB without Draco or Meshopt compression in the loader
P03.fix: Compress with gltf-transform (draco/meshopt) and textures to KTX2; wire DRACOLoader/KTX2Loader

P04.fix: Split WebGL and heavy libraries into lazy chunks; target ≈ 200 KB gz for the entry

P05.message: Too many or too heavy font files
P05.fix: Subset to the used ranges, ship ≤ 4 woff2 files, ≤ 400 KB total, preload the display face

P06.message: Uncapped devicePixelRatio for a WebGL renderer
P06.fix: renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2)) and cap the absolute pixel count on mobile

P07.message: WebGL renderer created without any dispose()
P07.fix: Dispose geometries, materials, textures and the renderer on route change

P08.fix: Reserve space for media, fonts and late content (width/height or aspect-ratio, size-adjust fallbacks, fixed slots); animate transform, never top, height or margin

P09.message: Image delivered below 1.5x the width it is drawn at (rendered)
P09.fix: Serve srcset candidates at 1.5x and 2x the drawn width (sizes from the layout), compressed to budget; a soft hero reads as unfinished on every phone

S03.fix: Add <meta name="theme-color"> from the ground token

S05.fix: Ship an SVG favicon in the world's ink

S06.fix: Author an OG image in the same world (1200×630)

S07.fix: Give every page a <title> that names the page and the subject; it is the first thing a crawler, a tab and a share sheet read

S08.fix: Write one sentence per page in the voice of the site; it is the snippet a search result shows

S09.message: No Open Graph title or description
S09.fix: Add og:title and og:description beside og:image so a shared link carries the page, not the domain

S10.fix: Add <link rel="canonical"> with the deployed URL of each page

S11.message: First screen without a readable h1 1.2 s after load (rendered)
S11.fix: Put the title in the HTML and paint it on the first frame: an h1 in the first viewport that says what this is, not held back by a loader, a gate or an entrance; a canvas that draws it keeps a DOM mirror

X01.message: Generic CTA copy (Get started / Learn more)
X01.fix: Name the action in the product's own words, matched to the stakes

X02.message: Placeholder copy or images (lorem ipsum, placeholder hosts, empty src)
X02.fix: Author real content at full fidelity; label synthetic material

X03.fix: Use a drawn icon set with one stroke weight, or no icon

X04.message: backdrop-filter on many selectors (glass by default)
X04.fix: Glass is a specific effect, not a surface style; keep it to one earned moment

X05.fix: Depth comes from luminance or optics unless the world is actually neo-brutalist

X06.message: Thick coloured side border on a card or callout
X06.fix: Remove the stripe; group by proximity and hierarchy instead

X07.message: Numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) or micro-meta (/ 01, No. 01)
X07.fix: Keep numbers only when the sequence carries meaning for the reader; P2 inside recipes/, which get copied

X08.fix: Numbers persuade as copy inside sentences (dual units, specifics), not as a stat row

X09.message: Decorative grid lines or stripes painted with gradients
X09.fix: A grid earns its lines when content sits on it; otherwise let the ground be a surface

X10.fix: Light comes from the world (a photograph, a scene, a material), not a glow placed behind the headline

X11.fix: Use depth by luminance or one material policy; neon glow is the default register, not a choice

X12.message: Generated palette (framework purple, violet or cyan; purple-to-pink gradient)
X12.fix: Derive ground and accent from the subject (references/reflex-lists.md); two to four tokens

X13.fix: UI settles on the expo-out vocabulary; keep overshoot for a thing that is a character, and record it as an exception

X14.message: Decorative idle loop (pulse, ping, blink, float)
X14.fix: Motion answers an event or the scroll; an endless pulse says nothing changed. Keep it only where state is live

X15.message: Every image zooms or turns on hover
X15.fix: Pick one hover behaviour that carries information (a preview, a caption, a state) or leave images still

X16.message: Slogan antithesis repeated (“Not X. A Y.”)
X16.fix: State what the thing does, with a number or a verb; one turn of phrase per page at most

X17.fix: Replace each claim with the fact behind it: a number, a unit, a named feature, an outcome

X18.fix: Most dashes want a full stop, a comma or a colon; keep the dash for a real interruption

X19.message: Hairline border plus wide soft shadow on one box
X19.fix: One edge per surface: a rule, a tone change or a shadow, not all at once

X20.fix: Flatten the inner level into rows or type; one container per idea

X21.message: Eyebrow labels above headings beyond one per three sections, by computed style (rendered)
X21.fix: Delete the labels the headings do not need; keep a set only when WORLD is a catalogue, index or spec sheet, and record it under ## Exceptions
